summary: Iteration 25 GREEN — Grande Mondo Phase 1 (Bibbia GM v0.2) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest (public URL): 11/11 pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_25_grande_mondo.py. Covers: demo login; /api/worlds includes gm_1 kind=GRANDE_MONDO size=3232 with 9 regions (IT FR ES DE AT RU CN UK PT) each size 600 slots 100, phase=ISOLATION seconds_left>0, my_region=IT for demo; register new account then POST /api/worlds/gm_1/join → 400 REGION_REQUIRED without region_code, 400 REGION_REQUIRED for 'XX', 200 for 'FR' with player.region_code=FR and world.grande_mondo.my_region=FR, world/regions player_count incremented, idempotent re-join OK; /api/worlds/gm_1/me for demo returns grande_mondo with fog_up=true and center.pyramid_anchor=[1616,1616], demo home inside IT square; /api/worlds/gm_1/grande-mondo returns full DTO + server_time; fog wall on chunks — demo→FR chunk fogged:true with settlements/sentinels/territory empty but terrain_b64 present; FR account same chunk not fogged with real settlements; demo home chunk not fogged; overview factor=8 size=404 and omits FR player settlements; marches/preview demo→FR neutral → 409 FOG_WALL, target_pyramid during ISOLATION → 409 FOG_WALL; QA POST /api/qa/grande-mondo/phase to WAR → phase=WAR fog_up=false seconds_left≈20d, FR chunk no longer fogged for demo, demo→FR preview NOT FOG_WALL (200/NO_LAND_PATH accepted), inbox has GRANDE_MONDO_PHASE payload.phase=WAR item, chronicle has GM_FOG_FALLEN entry; QA back to ISOLATION → phase=ISOLATION cycle>=2 fog_up=true, idempotent second call returns 200, FR chunk fogged again for demo; classic realms regression — world_1/world_2 kind REALM grande_mondo null, demo /worlds/world_1/me OK, marches/preview inside world_1 not FOG_WALL. No non-whitelisted console errors on any screen (only pre-existing shadow*/textShadow* RN deprecation notices).
action_items: INFO: Iteration 25 (Grande Mondo Phase 1 — mega-realm gm_1 with 9 regions, ISOLATION/WAR phase machine, fog-wall server enforcement on chunks/overview/marches, region join with region_code + REGION_REQUIRED validation, worlds list DTO, grande-mondo info screen, map fog chip, join sheet with region picker, inbox GRANDE_MONDO_PHASE) is verified end-to-end. World left in ISOLATION cycle 7. No fixes required from main agent.
critical_code_review_comments: app/domain/grande_mondo.py: transition() uses a conditional Mongo update ({gm.phase: cur}) so idempotent re-transitions to the current phase are no-ops without error — matches the requirement that posting the same phase twice returns current state; QA route relies on this correctly (transition returns the fresh world).

app/domain/grande_mondo.py: check_target() enforces the fog wall for all movements via A* zone grid; DTO exposes both fog_up and phase_until in ISO so client can display the countdown. Good separation of concerns (rule vs presentation).
app/api/routes_game.py join-body accepts region_code and delegates to worlds.join_world; 400 REGION_REQUIRED includes list of valid region codes in details — good UX signal for the client.

app/(tabs)/map.tsx map-gm-chip switches text between ISOLATION ('Nebbia') and WAR ('Guerra') with country flag + code; grande-mondo screen highlights my_region with a dedicated badge — matches the Bibbia GM spec.

app/worlds.tsx openJoin path splits UX: Grande Mondo uses the region list sheet (join-region-list → join-region-chosen → join-house-input) while classic realms show the house-name input directly; join-confirm-button posts region_code only when a GM region is chosen — clean.

success_rate.frontend: 8/8 flows verified with 0 non-whitelisted console errors
